command.openWebUI: Open the dsh Web UI in Browser
config.runtime.path: Path to the dsh executable. When empty, `dsh` is looked up on `PATH` (the command installed by DeepSeek Desktop, or `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`).
config.runtime.profile: dsh profile to start. Defaults to `web`, which shares models, API keys and permission presets with your own `dsh web`.
config.context.includeActiveEditor: Attach the active editor to messages by default: the selected code with line numbers when there is a selection, otherwise just the file path (dsh reads the file when it needs to). Each message can opt out with the chip above the input box.
config.ui.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (Chinese for Chinese, English otherwise)
config.ui.fontSize: Reading & chat font size (px), shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. `0` follows VS Code (workbench font size plus 1px).
config.ui.fontFamily: Reading & chat font family, shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. Empty follows the VS Code workbench font.
config.ui.lineHeight: Reading & chat line height, shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. `0` uses the default `1.6`.
config.ui.paragraphSpacing: Reading & chat paragraph spacing (px), shared by chat replies, plans, and Markdown file previews. `-1` uses the default `10`.
config.ui.contentWidth: Maximum content width (px) for chat replies, plans, and Markdown previews. `0` uses the default `820`.
config.ui.codeFontFamily: Monospace font family for terminal output, file paths, and code blocks. Empty follows `editor.fontFamily`.
config.ui.terminalFontSize: Font size (px) for terminal and command output. `0` uses the default `12`.
config.ui.terminalLineHeight: Line height for terminal and command output. `0` uses the default `1.6`.
config.ui.showTurnChanges: Show a changed-files card at the end of each reply. Off by default: the bar above the input box already lists the files changed in this session.
config.title: Harness Deck
container.title: Harness Deck
extension.description: A VS Code chat panel for coding agents: the built-in DeepSeek (dsh, DeepSeek Harness), or ACP agents such as Claude Code, Pi and CodeBuddy
capabilities.untrusted: The agent reads and writes files and runs commands in the workspace, so the workspace must be trusted.
config.backends: Extra agents reachable over ACP (Agent Client Protocol). DeepSeek (dsh), Pi (`omp acp`), CodeBuddy (`codebuddy --acp`) and Claude Code (`claude-agent-acp`) are built in; an entry with the `id` of a built-in one (`oh-my-pi`, `codebuddy`, `claude`) replaces it, for example to give the full path of the command. Each entry needs a `name` and the `command` (plus `args`) that starts the agent in ACP mode. Switch from the chat panel's Settings page or the "Switch Agent" command.
config.backends.id: Stable id (defaults to the name). Sessions and tabs are remembered per id.
config.backends.name: Name shown in the panel, e.g. `oh-my-pi`.
config.backends.command: Executable that speaks ACP over stdio, e.g. `omp`.
config.backends.env: Extra environment variables for the agent process.
config.backends.installHint: Shown when the command cannot be found.
config.backends.singleSession: Set to `true` if the agent only streams live updates for one session per process (CodeBuddy 2.x). The agent is then restarted before sending in another session. Overrides the built-in value when the entry replaces a built-in agent.
config.backendTrace: Troubleshooting: write every ACP message exchanged with the agent (raw JSON, long ones truncated) to the "Harness Deck: Backend" output channel. Use it to check what the agent actually sent, for example whether a reply had text between tool calls. Turn it off afterwards: messages include file contents.
config.ui.colorScheme: Full UI color scheme. Each scheme includes coordinated light and dark palettes that switch automatically with the theme.
config.ui.theme: Theme mode of the chat panel.
config.notifications.onlyWhenUnfocused: Only notify when the VS Code window is not in the foreground.
config.notifications.onAttention: Notify when the agent is waiting for your confirmation (approval, question, or plan review).
config.notifications.onTurnComplete: Notify when the agent finishes a turn.
config.notifications.onUnexpectedExit: Notify when the agent or runtime exits unexpectedly.
config.notifications.onScheduledComplete: Notify when a scheduled task or goal completes.
config.schedules.permission: Default unattended permission preset for scheduled tasks. Scheduled tasks open an isolated background session and run to completion with Full Access (`danger-full-access`) by default.
config.schedules.permission.workspace: Workspace Write (allow file edits inside workspace)
config.projects: Per-project worktree settings (files to copy, setup commands, and verification commands).
